capability: Grants an application the ability to access sensitive information about other running processes on the system, potentially bypassing standard sandbox restrictions or privacy controls that would otherwise restrict such access. This information could include process IDs (PIDs), names, paths, arguments, environment variables, memory usage, and other runtime details.
